subject: pudge_meat_hook
definition: 说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
evidence: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
钩中敌人后将打断持续施法类技能。

context.description_en: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
context.description_zh: 向一个单位或方向射出血腥的肉钩。勾住第一个遭遇的单位，并将它拖到帕吉身边，如果是非远古单位会被秒杀，其他敌方单位则是受到伤害。
notes_en: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.
notes_zh: 钩中敌人后将打断持续施法类技能。
肉钩能击中隐身单位。
肉钩可以穿过树木、地形、建筑、远古生物和肉山。
肉钩可以拖拽友方单位，不过他们不会受到伤害。
肉钩可以将神符拖拽至帕吉身旁，并返还肉钩的魔法消耗。

shard_loc.en: When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%.
shard_loc.zh: 肉钩击中敌人时会根据牵引距离造成额外伤害。肉钩击中友军时，肉钩的冷却时间会减少%cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%。

notes_en: Using Rot doesn't interrupt channeling.
Rot hits invisible units.
If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
Rot self-damage is non-lethal.
notes_zh: 使用腐烂不会打断持续施法。
腐烂能伤害隐身单位。
即使帕吉在开启腐烂后被沉默，腐烂也不会关闭。
腐烂的对己伤害不致死。

scepter_loc.zh: 腐烂的作用范围提升%bonus_rot_radius%，伤害提升%bonus_rot_damage%点，并且可以降低敌人的%scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%生命回复。

evidence: Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target.

移形换位会打断目标的持续施法。
移形换位能够打断持续施法。

context.description_zh: 与一个目标英雄瞬间交换位置，不论敌我。移形换位会打断目标的持续施法。敌方英雄被交换后受到伤害。复仇之魂和被交换的友方英雄都会获得等同于造成伤害的护盾。
notes_en: Works on Spell Immune units.
Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.
notes_zh: 对减益免疫单位有效。
技能施放后复仇之魂和目标附近的树木将会被摧毁。
移形换位能够打断持续施法。

notes_zh: 强力击将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.
notes_zh: 死亡守卫是无敌的，只有在巫医被打断或持续时间结束后才会被摧毁。
死亡守卫可以受到控制，选择攻击特定目标。
死亡守卫每0.22秒攻击一次。

CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

持续施法 - 使用生命汲取时，帕格纳吸取目标敌方单位的生命值，并获得其视野。

向队友施放可以将自己的生命值转移给队友。

When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by %spell_amp_drain_rate%%% per second up to a maximum of %spell_amp_drain_max%%% and increases his own, up to a maximum of %max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is %spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%% instead. Debuff lasts %spell_amp_drain_duration% seconds.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%abilitycooldown%秒。以敌方英雄为目标时，帕格纳每秒降低他们%spell_amp_drain_rate%%%技能伤害输出，最高可达到%spell_amp_drain_max%%%，并且自身的技能伤害输出提升，最高可达到%max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%。魔晶升级下对幽冥守卫施放时降低和提升的速率为%spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%%。负面效果持续%spell_amp_drain_duration%秒。

shard_loc.zh: 生命汲取可以对幽冥守卫施放，使生命汲取可以折射至守卫附近%abilitycastrange%范围内所有敌方英雄，造成%shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%%效果。守卫被摧毁后效果将会中断。

shard_loc.zh: 提升距离，并且使敌人穿过树木和高台时造成额外伤害。

subject: phoenix_sun_ray
definition: 说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
evidence: 凤凰可以使用物品和其他技能，不会打断烈日炙烤。

context.description_en: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their max health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
context.description_zh: 凤凰以损失生命能量为代价，向前射出一束炽热的光线炙烤敌人。光线对敌人造成伤害，并且能治疗友军，伤害和治疗的数值均为基础数值加上目标最大生命值的一定百分比。随着光线不断炙烤，百分比也会不断增加。
notes_en: Sun Ray has a width of %radius% units, and a length of %abilitycastrange% units.
Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
Phoenix can use items and abilities without canceling Sun Ray.
notes_zh: 烈日炙烤的宽度为%radius%，长度为%abilitycastrange%。
凤凰受到眩晕、沉默、飓风、妖术或睡眠等效果时烈日炙烤将会中断。
凤凰可以使用物品和其他技能，不会打断烈日炙烤。

shard_loc.en: Allows Sun Ray to be cast during Supernova.
shard_loc.zh: 超新星期间可以施放烈日炙烤。

subject: monkey_king_tree_dance
definition: 说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
evidence: Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.
齐天大圣受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时位移都会被打断。

context.description_en: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
context.description_zh: 齐天大圣跳上一棵树并停在上面。停留时获得乾坤之跃技能——需要持续施法的跳跃式攻击。如果树木被摧毁，他将从树上掉下，并眩晕%unperched_stunned_duration%秒。在地面受到伤害时丛林之舞将在一定时间内无法使用，处于冷却状态。
notes_en: Tree Dance cooldown starts upon landing.
Right-clicking the ground will have Monkey King drop from the tree.
Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.
notes_zh: 丛林之舞在落地时进入冷却。
右键点击地面后齐天大圣会从树上跳下。
齐天大圣受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时位移都会被打断。

subject: dark_willow_bramble_maze
definition: 说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
evidence: Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.
缠绕无法打断持续施法。

context.description_en: Dark Willow creates a %placement_range% AoE maze of %placement_count% brambles that grow in the target area after %initial_creation_delay% seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts %placement_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: %initial_creation_delay%秒后邪影芳灵在目标区域创造出%placement_range%范围的迷宫，迷宫拥有%placement_count%棵荆棘。进入荆棘的敌人将被缠绕，并且持续受到伤害。迷宫持续%placement_duration%秒。
notes_en: Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.
notes_zh: 缠绕无法打断持续施法。

subject: armlet
definition: 说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
evidence: Activating or deactivating Unholy Strength does not interrupt channeling.

abilities.title: Unholy Strength
abilities.description:
When active, Unholy Strength grants +35 damage, +25 strength and +4 armor, but drains 45 health per second.

 You cannot die from the health drain when Unholy Strength is activated, nor from the strength loss when Unholy Strength is deactivated.

context.notes:
The strength change will affect both maximum and current HP, but you cannot die from the change.
The strength change occurs over 0.6 seconds.
Activating or deactivating Unholy Strength does not interrupt channeling.

subject: force_staff
definition: 说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
evidence: Force Staff doesn't interrupt the target's actions.

abilities.title: Force
abilities.description: Pushes any target unit 600 units in the direction it is facing.

context.notes:
Self-cast will cause you to use Force on yourself.
Force Staff doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Force Staff has 850 cast range when cast on enemies.

subject: hurricane_pike
definition: 说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
evidence: Hurricane Pike doesn't interrupt the target's actions.

abilities.title: Hurricane Thrust
abilities.description:
Pushes you and target enemy 425 units away from each other, and for 5 seconds, allows you to make 5 attacks against the target without range restrictions and with +100 attack speed.

Can be cast on self or allies to push the target 600 units in the direction it is facing.
Enemy Range: 425

context.notes:
Self-cast will use Hurricane Pike on yourself.
Hurricane Pike doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.

subject: nevermore_necromastery
definition: 阻止目标闪烁、传送或离开范围；只是不能走的归定身
evidence: 影魔死亡时%soul_release_tooltip%%%的灵魂将逃离他的束缚。

context.description_en: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining %necromastery_damage_per_soul% bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant %souls_per_hero_kill% souls. On death, he releases %soul_release_tooltip%%% of them from bondage.
context.description_zh: 影魔每杀死一个单位都会窃取其灵魂，每个灵魂获得%necromastery_damage_per_soul%点额外攻击力。击杀英雄会获得%souls_per_hero_kill%个灵魂。影魔死亡时%soul_release_tooltip%%%的灵魂将逃离他的束缚。
notes_en: Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 反补、杀死中立生物也能收集到灵魂。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

subject: puck_dream_coil
definition: 阻止目标闪烁、传送或离开范围；只是不能走的归定身
evidence: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.
创造一个变化无常的的魔法梦境来困住敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害和束缚。

context.description_en: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
context.description_zh: 创造一个变化无常的的魔法梦境来困住敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害和束缚。如果被困住的敌方英雄试图挣脱缠绕走出梦境，将因为梦境破碎而受到眩晕和额外伤害。

scepter_loc.en: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.
scepter_loc.zh: 梦境缠绕作用下的所有敌人都会被帕克攻击，攻击频率基于帕克攻击频率的%attack_rate_pct%%%。即使目标挣脱梦境，被眩晕时攻击也会继续。

subject: sven_storm_bolt
definition: 阻止目标闪烁、传送或离开范围；只是不能走的归定身
evidence: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.

context.description_en: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.
context.description_zh: 斯温用他充满魔力的手套对目标周围内所有敌人造成伤害和眩晕。

scepter_loc.en: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离，并且对目标施加弱驱散效果。可以影响无敌目标。设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，额外造成%scepter_bonus_damage%点伤害并且斯温会跟随风暴之拳行进。

subject: windrunner_shackleshot
definition: 阻止目标闪烁、传送或离开范围；只是不能走的归定身
evidence: 将目标束缚在正对其后的一个敌方单位或树上。
该技能可以将两个敌人一起束缚，使他们同时眩晕。
束缚击能将目标束缚在身后最多%shackle_distance%距离的敌方单位或树木。
束缚击可以被躲避。

context.description_en: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to %fail_stun_duration%.
context.description_zh: 将目标束缚在正对其后的一个敌方单位或树上。若目标后面没有其它敌方单位或树木，则眩晕时间减少至%fail_stun_duration%秒。
notes_en: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most %shackle_distance% behind the target.
Shackleshot can be disjointed.
notes_zh: 该技能可以将两个敌人一起束缚，使他们同时眩晕。
束缚击能将目标束缚在身后最多%shackle_distance%距离的敌方单位或树木。
束缚击可以被躲避。
